items.statement: The submitted optimization is for the stated neutral singlet C14H12N4 molecule and the reported structure is validated as a local minimum by a frequency or equivalent curvature check.
items.expected: Identity, charge and multiplicity agree with the public molecule; optimization convergence is documented; no imaginary frequencies are reported for the accepted state.

items.statement: The agent provides reproducible computational provenance and explicit definitions for frontier descriptors.
items.expected: Software, electronic-structure method, basis, geometry strategy, provenance and descriptor formulas/sign conventions are stated.

items.statement: The calculated frontier-orbital quantities are reported in eV and the derived descriptor table is internally coherent.
items.expected: EHOMO, ELUMO, gap and all requested conceptual-DFT descriptors are present with units and consistent signs/formulas.
